name: alloy-virtual-lab-frontend
description: Front-end unificado do Alloy Virtual Lab (HEA Virtual Lab + CrystaLab) — React + TypeScript estrito.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.sw.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run measure && npm run e2e
scripts.e2e:etapa4: playwright test tests/e2e/etapa4-interaction.spec.ts tests/e2e/flow-a-density.spec.ts tests/e2e/flow-b-miller.spec.ts tests/e2e/a11y-keyboard.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:etapas5-7: playwright test tests/e2e/flow-c-hea.spec.ts tests/e2e/flow-d-instructor.spec.ts tests/e2e/flow-e-mobile-offline.spec.ts tests/e2e/etapas5-7.spec.ts tests/e2e/viewer-didactics.spec.ts tests/e2e/a11y-keyboard.spec.ts
